text:
Maya R: Heads up — starting network handoff for customer 'Orion Health' private deploy. Need to confirm final egress CIDR, cert bundle delivery method, and air-gap image sync owner. Ping owners.

Omar K: I have firewall contact: NetOps ticket #4567, owner is Liam. I'll add him. Also what's the preferred artifact transfer? s3 presigned or rsync over jumpbox?

Liam B: NetOps here. For egress, they allow only outbound HTTP/HTTPS through proxy; static IPs required. Can you post the final CIDR list? Also we need the list of service ports.

Maya R: CIDRs for runtime: 13.35.0.0/16, 52.95.0.0/17 — these are for telemetry & model fetch. Ports: 443 outbound, 123 for NTP (optional).

Liam B: We're OK with those two CIDRs. But proxy requires IPs, not CIDR — can you provide active IPs? We can reserve 3 NAT IPs.

Sophia P: We can supply NAT IPs from staging pool: 54.210.12.34, 54.210.12.35, 54.210.12.36. Would those work?

Omar K: Yes. Also cert rotation: do we push certs via KMS or deliver bundle to customer HSM? @Anita S

Anita S: Customer uses on-prem HSM. They want a signed cert chain + pkcs12 for the load balancer. We'll need to provision CSR and get them to sign. I can own CSR flow.

Maya R: Thanks. For air-gap image sync — we recommended tarball + sha256. Who will run image export? Also need a crontab for periodic updates.

Liam B: We can run the rsync from our jumpbox. Omar, please drop a script. It should run daily at 03:30 and output to /opt/images/orion

Omar K: Working on script. Draft here:
```bash
#!/bin/bash
rsync -avz --checksum rsync://artifact-host/orion/ /opt/images/orion/
sha256sum /opt/images/orion/*.tar.gz > /opt/images/orion/SHA256SUMS
```
I'll push to repo and ping for review.

Sophia P: :thumbsup: Please also include retention policy (how many versions). We recommend keep last 3.

Anita S: Note: air-gap transfer requires signed manifest. Add `manifest.sig` alongside SHA256SUMS.

deploy-bot: Reminder: runbook updated -> https://redwood.internal/runbooks/private-deploys/orion (edited)

Maya R: Next steps: Omar push script + PR by EOD, Anita start CSR and confirm HSM method, Liam confirm NAT allocation by tomorrow noon, Sophia confirm retention + cron. I'll consolidate in the ticket.

Liam B: Allocated NAT IPs confirmed in ticket #4567.

Omar K: PR up: https://phabricator.redwood/PR/789. Script includes retention and manifest signing call. @Sophia P can you review?

Sophia P: Reviewing now. Minor nit on logging; will comment on PR.

Maya R: Thanks all. I'll mark this thread resolved once PR merged and ticket closed.
